scope: Replacement firestore.secure.rules on staging; not production certification
summary: All browser writes denied; privileges require active server-approved ACL; user and history reads are authenticated; public projections omit phone and LINE UID. Tests exercise real Firestore rules and revoked authority.

findings.issue: Existing live rules previously verified to allow unauthenticated member/points/role writes.
findings.recommendation: Coordinated secure client/backend/rules rollout after verified backup and owner approval.

findings.issue: Legacy reset/reward functions bypass client rules; inventory/retirement requires approved production change.
findings.recommendation: Stop or replace every legacy member writer; retain unrelated POS printing services.

releaseBlockers: Production backup destination/key custody and restore of actual backup
Production POS wiring and continuous worker provision
Owner approval for coordinated production rollout and activation

checklist.authoritySource: server-owned ACL plus live role; backend admin pinned to owner
checklist.resourceLimits: server request size and input length/range limits; no client writes
checklist.typeSafety: server validates identity, month and safe integer balances
checklist.ownership: private user/history/reward reads scoped to identity or approved staff
